name: Affine Transformation Fixed-Point Reduction
description: Replaces the original scalar function composition with 2D affine vector transformations where stability is defined by the absence of fixed points. This forces the model to correctly perform symbolic matrix algebra over R^2 to deduce that f_u(f_v(V)) = V if and only if u=v. Models that rely on surface pattern matching or that hallucinate the matrix multiplication will fail to recognize it as a simple inequality constraint (2-coloring).
